title: centaurea nigrescens subsp. transalpina
intro: Centaurea nigrescens subsp. transalpina, commonly known as Alpine knapweed, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alpine knapweed include its ability to promote digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a valuable herbal remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
